detailed_descriptions.en: You awaken with no memories in a tranquil elven village devoted to worshipping the World Tree. All the elves living here are girls, and they have a unique request—they ask for your help in having children... Embrace a leisurely slow life filled with relaxation, and enjoy your days freely bonding with the charming and distinctive elven girls! Relaxing Slow-Life Activities Engage in farming: grow a variety of crops and care for livestock to fully experience ranch life. Experience seasonal changes in the village: enjoy gathering items, bug-catching, and fishing, along with special seasonal events. Develop and expand the village as you progress, unlocking new features and expanding your home. Build Relationships Chat with the elven girls, gift them items, and strengthen your bonds. Deepen your connections and unlock marriage possibilities—aim to build your dream harem by marrying every girl! Dress-Up and Customization Change the girls' outfits at any time, customizing colors to your preference. Explore a wide range of outfits, including everyday wear, uniforms, and fun cosplay costumes. Extra Content and Mini-Games Participate in exciting horse races with horses you've personally raised. Train your horse to become a champion in prestigious G1 races! Take on diverse challenges to earn trophies, and proudly display your achievements in your trophy room. Dive into this delightful world of relaxation, romance, and endless possibilities!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
You awaken with no memories in a tranquil elven village devoted to worshipping the World Tree.

All the elves living here are girls, and they have a unique request—they ask for your help in having children...

Embrace a leisurely slow life filled with relaxation, and enjoy your days freely bonding with the charming and distinctive elven girls!

Relaxing Slow-Life Activities

  • Engage in farming: grow a variety of crops and care for livestock to fully experience ranch life.

  • Experience seasonal changes in the village: enjoy gathering items, bug-catching, and fishing, along with special seasonal events.

  • Develop and expand the village as you progress, unlocking new features and expanding your home.

Build Relationships

  • Chat with the elven girls, gift them items, and strengthen your bonds.

  • Deepen your connections and unlock marriage possibilities—aim to build your dream harem by marrying every girl!

Dress-Up and Customization

  • Change the girls' outfits at any time, customizing colors to your preference.

  • Explore a wide range of outfits, including everyday wear, uniforms, and fun cosplay costumes.

Extra Content and Mini-Games

  • Participate in exciting horse races with horses you've personally raised. Train your horse to become a champion in prestigious G1 races!

  • Take on diverse challenges to earn trophies, and proudly display your achievements in your trophy room.

Dive into this delightful world of relaxation, romance, and endless possibilities!
